attributes.title: alarm_unshelve
attributes.description: Remove Alarm shelving at exact Alarm paths via system.alarm.unshelve. Unshelving is its own Tool: a shelve duration of zero is never a caller-visible unshelve. Wildcard targets are forbidden, so every path must be provider-qualified with no *: a pattern without * matches only the source it spells out, which is what keeps an unshelve from widening to a subtree. The result's Observed state is the alarm_shelved_list view of the exact paths and never decides success. Reads the Runtime Target Policy first and fails closed with operation_disabled when it is missing or unusable; a path outside the alarm_unshelve Target allowlist, or one that names the reserved IgnitionMCPPolicy provider (whatever the allowlist says, including an explicit *), fails with permission_denied before anything executes and records one audit decision row. Preflight checks every item before any item runs, with no rollback; items then execute one at a time. Runtime audit follows the policy's auditMode; a failed post-unshelve audit reports auditRecorded=false and stays a success, and the per-item outcomes are reported even when the Observed state is over its budget or cannot be serialized. The ignition-null-v1 encoding writes logical null as {"$ignition":"null"}. The default batch is 20 items, raisable by the policy's alarmMaxPaths up to the hard maximum of 100, with a finite aggregate input-byte budget; an over-budget request fails with limit_exceeded, the requested amount and the limit. Example: {"paths":["prov:default:/tag:AHU/AHU01:/alm:HighSetpoint"]}.

parameters.name: paths
parameters.description: 1..100 exact Alarm paths. Provider-qualified with no wildcard, for example prov:default:/tag:Folder/Tag:/alm:AlarmName. Default 20, raisable to the hard maximum of 100 by the Runtime Target Policy's alarmMaxPaths; at most 2048 characters per path and 65536 bytes for the whole list.
